parsed.rationale: Both `app:WatchXYC` (WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift:190) and `app:iOS` (WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Extensions.swift:27) declare an identical `extension SwiftUI.Image` with `shared_field_count: 2` and no differing slots, confirming exact duplication. Neither record carries any restraint marker (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), so consolidation is appropriate. The extension should be moved to a shared module — ideally a dedicated `Extensions` or `SharedUI` target that both the iOS app and the WatchXYC app already depend on, or at minimum into a single file that is linked by both targets. Keeping two identical SwiftUI.Image extensions risks silent divergence if one is updated without the other.
